turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. Why is there a zero next to my son's name, and why did I find out from Owen's phone instead of from you?
I didn't come for thanks. My son got a zero on a fifteen percent essay, and nobody called me first. What is your basis for it?
We're not finished. You asked for this meeting, Hale, and I haven't heard one thing I can check. What is your basis for the zero?
We're not finished. I'm sitting right here, and I'm still waiting for a document with a date on it. Or I go upstairs to the principal.
